items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 244:1
items.html: Assiyah is called the two thousand years of Tohu, for Tohu is the aspect of the Klipot, and in the world of Assiyah are all the Klipot. And the world of Yetzirah is the two thousand years of Torah, for Yetzirah is the aspect of ZA, and ZA is the Written Torah. And the world of Beriah is the two thousand years of the days of the Messiah, for Beriah is the aspect of Ima. And all redemption comes from the side of Ima, which is called freedom and liberation, and it is Leah, the mother of Mashiach ben David. (Items 63 and 111).
